name: Q0bs: coordination with no owners, across a two-site split
about: q0b with the team split into two sites from 0.2 to 5; the change request lands at 0.3 on both sides (the pm visits site B): a1 and a2 (site B) meet each other but not the hub, pm or a3 (site A, with the hub). Unlike q0bp nobody is alone: a claim made on either side is heard there, so two leads can exist until the sites meet again, and the earliest-claim rule (or the board merge) has to sort them out on heal. Claim leases are 20 minutes and renewed while held, so a 4.5-minute split exercises the same lead rule as an hours-long one.
brief: **This is a very short run (about 3 minutes of work, then waiting for it to be final).** The planner already works and `npm test` passes. Shortly after you start, the product manager lands a change request (`CHANGE-REQUEST.md` on main, and a `- [pm] CHANGE REQUEST ...` line in NOTES.md). Nobody is assigned: the team decides who does what. Build it once, between you, without stepping on each other. Your network may split for a while (some teammates reachable, others and the hub not); keep going.

roles.a1: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a2: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a3: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**

stop: Stop as soon as the change request is on main, final (the hub has it: `hs wait-final`, or no provisional line in `hs status`) and `npm test` passes there, or at minute 8 (`date` against when you started), whichever comes first. Do not wait for teammates to finish.
